## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

State the tests or manual checks you ran, their results and the platforms actually tested. Note any remaining limitation. Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, using public or synthetic data.

## Relevant checks

- [ ] Added or updated meaningful regression coverage for changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] Updated user-facing documentation and affected translations, where applicable.
- [ ] Checked shared-module availability in the Android package if Python imports changed.
- [ ] Removed credentials, personal query content, generated packages and signing material from this change.
